A '''mercenary pilot''' served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he traveled to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to guard the execution of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. During the execution, Skywalker fought back and killed the pilot.

==Biography==
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="RotJ date" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="RotJ" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Blog" /> mercenary pilot<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck|cardname=Mercenary Pilot}}</ref> served [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="RotJ" /> a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> operating out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2012 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 1|cardname=Skiff Guard|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73989/cid/5329980/2012-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-349-Skiff-Guard}}</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="RotJ date" /> he<ref name="CCG" /> worked as a [[Skiff guard/Legends|skiff guard]]<ref name="Topps" /> and he accompanied other guards on a<ref name="RotJ" /> [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiff]]<ref name="Skiff">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Bantha-II Cargo Skiff}}</ref> as they and Jabba traveled to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in Tatooine's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], to execute the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his allies. As they arrived at the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that lay within Carkoon, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the skiff,<ref name="RotJ" /> [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]],<ref name="Pote">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Pote Snitkin|link=POTF2potesnitkin.asp}}</ref> rode around it in circles.<ref name="RotJ" />

[[File:ForceKick3-ROTJ.png|thumb|400px|right|The mercenary was kicked by Luke Skywalker, leading to his death.]]
From his [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], Jabba then offered the prisoners a chance to beg for their lives, before ordering Skywalker's death. With help from his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the Jedi retrieved his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|began fighting]] the guards on his skiff. After Skywalker dispatched all of them, the mercenary pilot's skiff closed in on Skywalker's skiff. The Jedi jumped onto the mercenary's vehicle and attacked<ref name="RotJ" /> the skiff guard<ref name="Topps" /> [[Brock Starsher/Legends|Brock Starsher]].<ref name="Rogues gallery">{{InsiderCite|143|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Jabba's Henchmen!}}</ref> After Starsher fell into the sarlacc, the mercenary pilot rushed over to attack Skywalker, who<ref name="RotJ" /> used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]<ref name="TOR: Force Kick">{{TORcite|Force Kick|type=other}}</ref> to kick him in the head, causing him to fall into the sarlacc as well.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Personality and traits==
The mercenary pilot had skin with light complexion.<ref name="RotJ" />

==Equipment==
During the execution, the skiff guard wore a [[Color/Legends|tan]] [[Clothing/Legends|jumpsuit]], a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], crossing brown [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoliers]], and a black [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. He armed himself with a [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mercenary_pilot_set_photo.jpg|thumb|250px|An on-set photo of the actor portraying the mercenary]]
The mercenary pilot first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="RotJ" />

The character is on the receiving end of what is called a "[[Force kick]]," referring to a particularly poorly choreographed and shot fight sequence in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], in which [[Mark Hamill]]/Luke Skywalker kicks the mercenary in the head, causing him to fall into the sarlacc pit. The term jokingly suggests that Luke uses [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force telekinesis]] to make the henchman fall, rather than the physical impact of the kick.

The character was finally given the name [[Sion]] in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[2023]]'s anthology book ''[[From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="FACPOV">{{StoryCite|story=Kickback (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>
